scope: CPU cached Dorian validation only; no model inference, GPU, observed-test scoring or policy selection from test cases
inputs: Original version-1 matched-GPU MiniLM/RoBERTa validation predictions and separate Dorian gold; 29 official questions plus four authored unknown controls

hypotheses.name: source_consensus
hypotheses.rule: Group normalized answer strings; deduplicate overlapping occurrences by global source intervals. Add weight*log(1+min(2,distinct_nonoverlapping_occurrences-1)) to the best margin-minus-rank score. Repetition is supporting agreement, not independent semantic evidence.

hypotheses.name: ambiguity_gap
hypotheses.rule: Collapse identical normalized answer strings, retain the maximum adjusted score per string, and abstain if the best two different strings have score gap below the chosen minimum.

hypotheses.name: cross_reader_agreement
hypotheses.rule: Filter MiniLM spans to exact book/start/end agreement with a RoBERTa candidate above its margin cutoff; then apply the frozen MiniLM selector. Diagnostic only unless deployment mechanics can be validated without additional model inference.

fixed_miniLM_eligibility: Finite null margin >0; valid positive integer retrieval rank; exact source offsets. No negative MiniLM threshold expansion.
normalization: Same lower-case, punctuation/article removal as conventional QA scorer; no gold-dependent normalization or substring matching
primary_objective: Mean conventional answer token F1 minus0.25 authored-control false-answer rate

either: Noninferior token F1 and at least3 fewer accepted answers that do not exactly match any gold reference

ties: Larger objective, larger EM, fewer accepted gold-EM-mismatching answers, smaller policy magnitude, hypothesis order
annotation_limits: A gold EM mismatch is not proof of incorrectness or unsupported interpretation. Reused29-question validation and4 authored controls provide no independent calibration claim.
historical_tests_excluded: A Sentimental Journey Through France and Italy
stopping: Evaluate these nine policies and baseline once from cached spans; no refined grids after outcomes. Preserve all negatives. If nothing qualifies, retain production baseline and implement only separately verified reliability/audit mechanics.
